deploy-bot: Tagged deploy started -> production (eu-west-1). Release tag: v1.7.2-hotfix. Commit: 4f3b9a2. Canary 5% traffic. Change window: immediate. / Deploy links: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/4567

lucy: Ack, watching. Hold for 15m canary stability before any manual promote. Will call if we see regression. :eyes:

jamal: Oncall here — I’ve opened a live dashboard and pinned error-rate + token-p99. Alerting thresholds set (error-rate > 2%).

priya: Runtime note: pinned quantization profile to `safe-1` for this rollout to avoid perf regressions on older GPUs.

alex: Can you paste the commit summary? want to double-check the tokenizer change is the one we tested.

deploy-bot: Commit summary:
```
commit 4f3b9a2
Author: amira@redwood.ai
Summary: fix(tokenizer): handle 0-width joiners in vtokenizer, prevent OOB in decode path
Files: model/vtokenizer.cpp, tests/tokenizer_edgecases.test
```

niko: If canary passes at +15m, promote to 25% and verify regional latencies for another 20m. Manual rollback plan: `/release rollback v1.7.2-hotfix` or run: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-inference -n prod --to-revision=1234`

qa-bot: Canary smoke-run started: chat-gen, embedding-store, batch-runner. Current status: chat-gen ok, embedding-store running, batch-runner queued. Logs streamed to https://logs.redwood.internal/canary/1987659999

jamal: Small token-p99 spike to 2.1s at +7m; CPU and GPU utilization normal. No error-rate increase. Continuing to observe.

lucy: OK rolling to 25% now per plan. Leaving monitoring hooked; will update in 10m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary -> 25% complete. No new errors reported in last 10m. Next ETA full: ~20m if stable.

alex: Noted release-note entry: "v1.7.2-hotfix: tokenizer edge-case fix (reduces OOB decodes); pinned quant profile; no model weight change." Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v1.7.2-hotfix

niko: Standing by for promote. If error-rate exceeds 3% at any region during promotion, we rollback immediately.

lucy: Thanks everyone. If no objections, promote to 100% after the second verification window.

jamal: Copy — will trigger a rollback if errors trend up.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% scheduled in 20m assuming canary holds. End of thread updates will follow here.
